Food-allergy counseling

Choose the single best answer, then reveal the explanation.

A child receiving omalizumab to reduce reactions from accidental food exposure has fewer reactions. The family asks whether the child may now intentionally eat the trigger food and discard prescribed emergency medication. Which counseling point is correct?

  1. Continue allergen avoidance and retain the emergency treatment plan
  2. Intentional exposure is safe after the first tolerated injection
  3. Omalizumab replaces emergency treatment during anaphylaxis
  4. Avoidance is unnecessary whenever symptoms improve
  5. Protection can be guaranteed by increasing the next dose after exposure
Reveal answer and explanation
Correct answer

Continue allergen avoidance and retain the emergency treatment plan

Omalizumab reduces risk from accidental exposure; it does not make intentional exposure safe or treat acute anaphylaxis.

Understanding the options

Continue allergen avoidance and retain the emergency treatment plan
Omalizumab reduces risk from accidental exposure; it does not make intentional exposure safe or treat acute anaphylaxis.
Intentional exposure is safe after the first tolerated injection
Treatment does not establish tolerance to intentional ingestion.
Omalizumab replaces emergency treatment during anaphylaxis
It is not emergency anaphylaxis treatment.
Avoidance is unnecessary whenever symptoms improve
Improvement does not remove the need for avoidance.
Protection can be guaranteed by increasing the next dose after exposure
There is no such guaranteed post-exposure rescue strategy.
